questions.text: What is described as one of the greatest environmental disasters in history?
opts: The disappearance of the Aral Sea
questions.correct: The disappearance of the Aral Sea
questions.hint: Paragraph 2: "This is considered one of the greatest environmental disasters in history."

questions.text: Kazakhstan plans to produce 30% of electricity from renewables by 2030.
questions.hint: Paragraph 3: the goal is 15%, not 30%.

questions.text: The WKU Eco Club organises:
questions.hint: Paragraph 4: "They organise tree-planting events, recycling campaigns, and awareness programmes."

questions.text: Zhibek says: "We don't ___ the Earth — we borrow it from our children."
questions.hint: Last paragraph of the reading: "We don't inherit the Earth from our ancestors."

questions.text: According to the article, what is replacing plastic bags?
questions.hint: Paragraph 5: "Plastic bags are being replaced by reusable ones."

questions.text: What does Zhibek say is wasted every day at WKU?
questions.hint: Statement 1: "She says that a lot of food at WKU is wasted every day."

questions.text: Rustam started using a reusable water bottle and bag.
questions.hint: Statement 5: "He says he has started using a reusable water bottle and bag."

questions.text: How many friends will Kamila bring to the next meeting?
questions.hint: Statement 6: "She says she will bring five friends to the next Eco Club meeting."

questions.text: What does the Eco Club do every spring?
questions.hint: Statement 4: "She explains that trees are planted every spring by the club."

questions.text: Rustam joined the Eco Club after seeing a documentary about plastic ___.
questions.hint: Statement 2: "after seeing a documentary about plastic pollution."

questions.text: Present simple passive form is:
questions.hint: Present passive: is/are + past participle.

questions.text: English ___ (speak) in over 50 countries.
questions.hint: Present passive: is + spoken.

questions.text: Change to passive: "The factory produces cars."
opts: Cars are produced by the factory.
Cars is produced by the factory.
questions.correct: Cars are produced by the factory.
questions.hint: "Cars" = subject; "are produced" = passive; "by the factory" = agent.

questions.text: Past passive form is:
questions.hint: Past passive: was/were + past participle.

questions.text: The stadium ___ (build) by a Kazakh construction company in 2015.
questions.hint: Past passive: was + built.

questions.text: Future passive "500 trees ___ next spring." Fill in:
questions.hint: Future passive: will be + planted.

questions.text: "Plastic must be recycled" is a correct modal passive.
questions.hint: Modal passive: must be + recycled. ✅

questions.text: A new sports hall ___ (build) near the dormitory right now.
questions.hint: Present continuous passive: is being + built.

questions.text: "A cure has been discovered" uses which tense?
questions.hint: has/have been + past participle = present perfect passive.

questions.text: "By + agent" is always required in passive sentences.
questions.hint: "By + agent" is optional — only include it when the doer is important information.

questions.text: "Renewable energy" comes from:
opts: Sources that can be naturally replenished
questions.correct: Sources that can be naturally replenished
questions.hint: "Renewable" = can be replenished naturally. Solar, wind, and water are renewable.

questions.text: "Fossil fuels" include:
questions.hint: "Fossil fuels" = non-renewable energy formed from ancient organisms: coal, oil, gas.

questions.text: "Climate change" refers only to temperature rising.
questions.hint: "Climate change" includes rising temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, extreme weather events, etc.

questions.text: She sorted her rubbish and ___ the glass and plastic.
questions.hint: "Recycle" = process used materials to make new products.

questions.text: "Glacier" is:
opts: A large slow-moving mass of ice
questions.correct: A large slow-moving mass of ice
questions.hint: "Glacier" = a large body of ice moving slowly over land.

questions.text: "Pollution" means:
opts: Introducing harmful substances into the environment
questions.correct: Introducing harmful substances into the environment
questions.hint: "Pollution" = contamination of the environment with harmful substances.

questions.text: "Eco-friendly" products are harmful to the environment.
questions.hint: "Eco-friendly" = not harmful to the environment; designed to cause minimal damage.

questions.text: "Sustainable" development means:
opts: Development that meets current needs without harming future generations
questions.correct: Development that meets current needs without harming future generations
questions.hint: "Sustainable" = able to continue without depleting resources or causing permanent damage.

questions.text: "Irrigation" is the process of:
questions.hint: "Irrigation" = artificially supplying water to land for agricultural purposes.

questions.text: She uses a ___ water bottle to avoid buying plastic ones.
questions.hint: "Reusable" = can be used many times, not thrown away after one use.
